notes.title: Patch Notes 1.09

[list]
[*] New ON/OFF toggle setting for motion blur animation when dashing.
[i]*Dash effects setting can be changed from SETTINGS > System Setting > Dash Effects.[/i]

notes.title: Metaphor: ReFantazio Out Now!
notes.content:
The day has finally arrived: [b]Metaphor: ReFantazio is now available[/b]! 

Please enjoy this adventure into a vast fantasy world, an RPG that brings together the many RPGs created by ATLUS—including the Shin Megami Tensei and Persona series—and is also the culmination of the 35th anniversary of the brand!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2679460/Metaphor_ReFantazio/

[previewyoutube=W9UW9l87aUE;full][/previewyoutube]
---
[h2]Soejima Launch Illustration[/h2]
To celebrate the launch of the game, Character Designer Shigenori Soejima has shared a special illustration!

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GZlNRBzXMAsAQ47?format=jpg&name=4096x4096[/img]
---
[h2]Try the Prologue Demo![/h2]
Download and play the free Prologue Demo! The demo allows you to experience the beginning of the game, including exploring the first four dungeons, the ability to unlock seven Archetypes classes, and the opportunity to meet six followers. Best yet, your demo save data carries over to the full version.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3130330/Metaphor_ReFantazio__Prologue_Demo/

All achievement progress from the Prologue Demo will also carry over to the full game if you decides to carry over your demo save data. Achievements are not unlocked immediately when loading save data from the demo, the conditions need to be achieved once more into the full game to get unlocked. For example, one of the achievements is "No Mercy". If you finished 50+ battles with no damage in the demo, then the next time you achieve a no-damage battle in the full product, this achievement will get unlocked.

Achievements with completed progress including story-based achievements will unlock automatically when the next story-based achievement is unlocked.

notes.title: The World Tour Hits Asia and Europe!
notes.content:
All summer long, we've been on a world tour bringing Metaphor: ReFantazio to fans. In early July, our gauntlet runner landed at [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2679460/allnews/]Anime Expo[/url], where we held the first public demo in North America.

More recently, our travels have taken us across Asia, showing off the game to fans in Tokyo at ATLUS Fes, Shanghai at BilibiliWorld 2024, Manila at Philippine GameDev Expo, and Taipei at the Comic Exhibition. Thank you to everyone we've met along the way!

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GVoYy-0XkAAqTCN?format=jpg&name=medium[/img]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GVoYy-UbgAUiiYI?format=jpg&name=medium[/img]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GVoYy-TbgAQn25u?format=jpg&name=medium[/img]

This week the road trip hits Europe, where we're setting up at gamescom in Cologne, Germany. This is an opportunity for attending fans to get hands-on with the demo, take a photo in front of the Seeker statue, and leave with a tote bag!

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GVoYsuMasAEFcCH?format=jpg&name=4096x4096[/img]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GVoYsuNbgAMKOXb?format=jpg&name=4096x4096[/img]

For those at home, we didn't want to leave you empty-handed: Check out our latest trailer, as we invite you to "Travel Beyond Fantasy" with us.
